payload.title: Supermarket and shopping
payload.shortDescription: Find products, pay, compare choices, and solve common shopping problems.

lessons.$comment: Expand this A1 lesson to the full authoring contract.
lessons.title: A1 · Find products and pay
lessons.subtitle: Basic supermarket questions and checkout

situation.en: You need help finding a product in a supermarket.
situation.te: సూపర్‌మార్కెట్‌లో ఒక వస్తువు ఎక్కడ ఉందో అడగాలి.

context.speaker: Customer
context.nl: Waar kan ik de melk vinden?
context.en: Where can I find the milk?

sentences.nl: Waar kan ik de melk vinden?
sentences.en: Where can I find the milk?

explanation.en: Use this frame to ask where you can find a product.
explanation.te: ఒక వస్తువు ఎక్కడ దొరుకుతుందో అడగడానికి ఈ నమూనాను వాడండి.

exercises.context: Waar kan ik de melk vinden?
choices: Where can I find the milk?
accepted: Where can I find the milk?
exercises.feedback: This asks where the milk is.

lessons.$comment: Expand this A2 lesson to the full authoring contract and keep its outcome/pattern distinct from A1.
lessons.title: A2 · Product information and problem resolution
lessons.subtitle: Ask for details and resolve a shopping problem
outcomes: Ask an employee to check product information politely.

situation.en: You need product information or help with a shopping problem.
situation.te: ఒక వస్తువు గురించి సమాచారం లేదా సమస్యకు సహాయం కావాలి.

context.speaker: Customer
context.nl: Kunt u controleren of dit glutenvrij is?
context.en: Could you check whether this is gluten-free?

sentences.nl: Kunt u controleren of dit glutenvrij is?
sentences.en: Could you check whether this is gluten-free?

explanation.en: Use this polite frame when asking staff to check information.
explanation.te: సిబ్బందిని సమాచారం చూసి చెప్పమని మర్యాదగా అడగడానికి ఈ నమూనాను వాడండి.

lessons.supportingObservation: Use u in a service-desk interaction.

exercises.context: You need an employee to check the ingredients.
choices: Kunt u controleren of dit glutenvrij is?
accepted: Kunt u controleren of dit glutenvrij is?
exercises.feedback: Use Kunt u controleren of ...? for a polite check.

completionClaims: Ask an employee to check product information politely.
